opportunities.title: FAQ assistant for customer questions
opportunities.description: Use an AI assistant to answer common customer questions. Send difficult questions to a person.
risks: The assistant can give wrong answers. Check the answers each week.
Tell customers that they talk to an AI assistant.
Do not let the assistant see payment data or health data.

opportunities.title: Draft replies for support emails
opportunities.description: Let AI write a first draft of each reply. A person checks and sends the reply.
risks: A person must check each draft before it is sent.
Customer emails contain personal data. Use a tool with a data processing agreement.

opportunities.title: Product descriptions and listings
opportunities.description: Generate product titles and descriptions from a short specification. Translate them to more languages.
risks: Check facts such as size, material and safety claims before you publish.
Let a native speaker check each translation.

opportunities.title: Social media content plan
opportunities.description: Make a weekly plan of posts and first drafts of the text. A person approves each post.
risks: A person must approve each post before it is published.
Do not use images or text that you do not have the rights to.

opportunities.title: Lead sorting and follow-up
opportunities.description: Sort new leads by fit and draft follow-up messages. Record the result in the CRM.
risks: Lead data is personal data. Use a tool with a data processing agreement.
A person must make the final decision about each lead.

opportunities.title: Faster quotes and offers
opportunities.description: Make quote documents from a template and the customer request. A person checks prices.
risks: A person must check prices, discounts and terms before the quote is sent.
Keep the price list up to date. Old prices give wrong quotes.

opportunities.title: Read invoices and receipts automatically
opportunities.description: Extract data from invoices and receipts and put it into the accounting system.
risks: Check the amounts and VAT numbers before you book them.
Keep the original invoice for the accounting records.

opportunities.title: Monthly finance summary
opportunities.description: Make a short summary of income, costs and trends from the monthly export.
risks: Financial data is confidential. Do not upload it to a tool that trains on your data.
Check the numbers in the summary against the export.

opportunities.title: Stock and reorder forecast
opportunities.description: Use sales history to estimate when to reorder stock and how much to order.
risks: The forecast can be wrong after a large change, for example a new product or a sale.
A person must approve each order.

opportunities.title: Supplier messages and translation
opportunities.description: Draft and translate messages to suppliers. Summarise long supplier threads.
risks: Check prices, dates and quantities in each message before you send it.
Do not share confidential contract terms with the tool.

opportunities.title: Meeting notes and action items
opportunities.description: Record meetings, make a summary and a list of tasks for each person.
risks: Tell all persons in the meeting before you record it.
A person must check the summary and the list of tasks.
Delete the recordings when you do not need them.

opportunities.title: Search internal documents
opportunities.description: Let staff ask questions about internal documents, for example procedures and price lists.
risks: The answers can be wrong or old. Show the source document with each answer.
Control which staff can see which documents.
